title: Genuine Multi-Entropy of Fully Symmetric Gaussian States
summary: We study the tri-partite genuine Rényi multi-entropy of fully symmetric Gaussian states as a function of the squeezing parameter for different total number of bosonic modes under different subsystem configurations. Exact results for a few modes are obtained, and we conjecture an asymptotic formula at the limit of large squeezing parameter as a function of the replica index $n$, while also finding subleading subsystem-size dependent terms for $n=3$ under a specific tripartition.
